title: 分组
summary: 信息块分组不是默认套卡片。卡片只装真正独立的对象，关系才是分组的答案。
summaryEn: Grouping UI chunks should not default to cards. Cards belong to truly independent objects; semantic relationships dictate the boundaries.
asks: 信息块该怎么组织与隔断？
asksEn: How should related content chunks be grouped and separated?
